title: Activate the production Claude Plan at claude-worker-launch-replay
problem: PROJECT.md points at Plan enable-bounded-local-native-release-manager-coordination-with-durable-addressed, whose current Action native-rm-checkpoint-roundtrip is host-only and blocked, so no agent can advance the Project. The critical-path Plan arcadia-runs-production-unattended-on-its-own-repository-on-the-claude-provider is draft with its first ready Action claude-worker-launch-replay, and no phone path could re-point the Project until now.
desired_effect: Accept Agent Ask activate-production-claude-plan-20261017 with --activate --action claude-worker-launch-replay --model standard --effort medium --top: arcadia-runs-production-unattended-on-its-own-repository-on-the-claude-provider becomes the active Plan at claude-worker-launch-replay (standard / medium, as its recommended_model and PR #1406 chose), enable-bounded-local-native-release-manager-coordination-with-durable-addressed returns to draft with every Action and completion state preserved, and this Project's queue segment moves to the top. Revival trigger for the parked native-mail Plan: first-unattended-run is done, or the native coordination gap blocks a production run.

does: Runs the shared Plan runner's canonical preview, refuses any drift from the pinned before-images or any effect outside the pinned after-images, then applies with identical flags.

Sets PROJECT.md active_plan, current_action and milestone; sets the activated Plan's status, current_action, recommended_model and recommended_reasoning_effort; returns the previous Plan to draft and clears its current_action; appends one MISSION_LOG.md entry; archives the pinned Ask.
Replaces this Project's queue segment at the top with the activated Plan's unfinished Actions in dependency order; every other Project keeps its relative order.
Publishes the one settlement commit with a normal push to origin main and keeps a durable receipt.
never_does: Never starts a Session, Run, Grant, production run, service restart or merge.
Never changes any Action's title, status, criteria, dependencies or responsibility in either Plan, including the native-mail Actions.
Never settles a different Ask, a changed Ask, or a second time; a repeat click verifies and replays the existing settlement.
Never force-pushes or publishes unrelated local commits.

success.effect: Project arcadia points at arcadia-runs-production-unattended-on-its-own-repository-on-the-claude-provider / claude-worker-launch-replay; the native-mail Plan is draft; the settlement commit is on origin main.
success.next: The next production tick or Lead dispatch picks up claude-worker-launch-replay from the queue top. Keep the receipt.

failure.effect: The runner refused before mutation (or, after a local commit, before publication) and recorded the exact reason in its receipt and failure handoff.
failure.next: Read the receipt reason: drift or a running Session means re-ask with fresh pins or reconcile the Session; a publication failure is retried by pressing again, which publishes the existing settlement without applying twice.

projectBefore.milestone: Enable bounded local native Release Manager coordination with durable addressed messages, explicit checkpoint roundtrip proof, and explicit generation-fenced manager handoff.

projectAfter.milestone: Arcadia runs production unattended on its own repository on the Claude provider: the worker launches a Session, preserves a reviewed PR, merges it through the PR when it is not authority-adjacent, and continues to the next Action within a spend bound, with operator touches limited to authority-adjacent merges.
